headline: Executive order creates a new national award named after entertainer Bob Hope, called the Bob Hope American Patriot Award.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new award called the Bob Hope American Patriot Award. No summary was provided, so details such as who can receive it, who chooses winners, and how often it is given are not covered here.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 28, 2003; the exact effective date was not provided.
